name: Two Sigma

roles.title: Software Engineer (Quantitative Research Platform)
roles.notes: Official job posting: designs simulation orchestration and financial analytical software enabling quantitative research, and core components of the quant research platform.

roles.title: Quantitative Researcher
roles.notes: Title listed on Two Sigma's own careers portal among its new openings (New York, Quantitative Research function).

roles.title: Engineering. Data Platforms / Infrastructure
roles.notes: Two Sigma's careers portal lists Engineering as an explore-role team alongside Quantitative Research, Strategy & Operations, and Investment & Client Solutions.

publishedExpectations.claim: An official Software Engineer posting requires Python, Java, and SQL; relational database concepts and complex SQL queries; and distributed and large-scale software systems design, implementation and maintenance.

The same posting requires Linux/Unix operating systems, object-oriented programming, software testing frameworks, and the ability to analyze and identify causes of performance problems such as bottlenecks.

The posting explicitly requires 'understanding of mathematical concepts in quantitative finance including Linear Algebra, Probability and Statistics, and Time Series Analysis, and Financial Engineering', and states candidates must pass the company's required skills assessment.

Duties include engineering simulation orchestration and attribution-analysis frameworks for quantitative research, thorough testing frameworks for mission-critical systems, and gathering OS/application software metrics for performance tuning.
Two Sigma's careers portal describes a collaborative environment where engineers innovate 'alongside pioneers in statistics, distributed computing, financial markets, and other business disciplines'.

notes: Two Sigma's main careers site was bot-blocked at retrieval, but its own careers portal (careers.twosigma.com) and an official Software Engineer posting were retrieved; the posting is unusually detailed, naming Python/Java/SQL, distributed systems, Linux, testing, performance tuning and the quant-finance math trio (linear algebra, probability & statistics, time series). It also confirms a mandatory company skills assessment. Community-reported patterns (unverified): puzzle-driven interviews probing statistical intuition and modelling, plus large-scale design discussions; no retrieved official page describes interview rounds. Compensation bands on the posting ($165k-$325k base for this NY role) are the firm's own stated range.
